units: pixels (x right, y down, full 2560x1440 resolution) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (frames 68-71 are identical to the empty background within 14 grey levels; no pan or shake)
camera.notes: Rendered with a perspective camera at roughly car height: the car's apparent bbox length shrinks from ~1023 px (frame 9) to ~973 px (frame 52) as it crosses (more of the rear is seen on the right, more of the front on the left). Motion is horizontal in the image plane; the reference-point y stays at ~885 px.

objects.name: hovercar
objects.description: The only object: a dark grey and white futuristic hover car / flying car with a light canopy, two thin antennas on the rear deck and light mechanical underparts. It hovers (no wheels touching) above the floor, nose pointing LEFT.
objects.visible_frames: 0-67 (frames 0-8 rear clipped by right image edge; 9-52 fully visible; 53-67 front clipped by left edge, only a sliver at 66-67); absent 68-71
objects.reference_point: ref_x = bbox centre x (fully visible frames); for clipped frames extrapolated from the visible edge using the fitted apparent length L(f) = 1034.5 - 1.183*f px; ref_y = bbox centre y (~885 px, constant)

size_px_fully_visible.bbox_length_px: 1023 at frame 9 ... 1001 at frame 30 ... 975 at frame 52 (median 1002.5); use the value at the frame of the question, or ~1000 at mid-frame
size_px_fully_visible.bbox_height_px: 315 (y 728-1042, includes antennas; top antenna tip at y 728, lowest underbody part at y ~1033-1042)
size_px_fully_visible.hover_gap_px: lowest car part y ~1042 to shadow top y 1076: ~34 px (car bottom to floor shadow)

objects.name: hovercar_shadow
objects.description: Dark elongated shadow of the car on the light floor, directly below it (y 1076-1130); moves with the car.

objects.name: studio_backdrop_floor
objects.description: Seamless grey studio cyclorama: darker grey wall at top, light grey floor below, soft curved transition around y ~950-1050. No markings, no other props.
objects.size_px: fills the frame; no measurable edges

events.event: car at rest / start of motion
events.note: front edge x0 = 1577 at frames 0 and 1, 1576 at 2, then moves left with steadily growing per-frame steps

events.event: car rear fully enters the frame
car front reaches the left image edge

events.note: no bounces, contacts or direction changes; motion is purely leftward (-x), accelerating smoothly throughout (per-frame step ~-1 px at frame 2 to ~-58 px at frame 52 and ~-70 px at frame 66)

files.tracks/hovercar.csv: per-frame car track (all 72 frames, visible flag)
files.scripts/: track.py (segmentation + CSVs), overlay.py (visual check), check.py (per-frame steps), explore.py
